t: A round learning board packed with lights, sensors and a speaker.
steps: Buy the board from Adafruit or a maker shop such as PiShop.us.
Get a micro-USB cable that carries data.
Open the MakeCode for Adafruit editor in a web browser. No install is needed.
Drag a block that makes the lights glow a color.
Press Download and save the file.
Press the reset button once. Drag the file onto the board drive that appears.
Try the shake block next to make the board react to motion.
meta: Wild Open. From $24.95. A few stores.
